subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Pipe Friction: The Moody Chart
description: A fast breakdown of Pipe Friction: The Moody Chart for builders.

hook.text: Push water through a pipe and pressure drops. The pipe walls fight back.

buildup.text: Pipe roughness and fluid speed together set how much energy is lost.

discovery.text: The Moody chart maps friction factor against Reynolds number and roughness.

twist.text: In turbulent flow, even tiny surface bumps cause big pressure losses.

climax.text: Engineers size pumps using this chart. Get it wrong and the pump can't deliver.

punchline.text: One chart saves engineers from guessing about pipe losses.

quiz.question: What two factors does the Moody chart relate?
options: Reynolds number and surface roughness to friction factor
